name: branding-yellow-dachshund-leaping-over-fat-boop-wordmark-on-brown
title: Butter-yellow jumping dachshund silhouette above a fat lowercase 'boop' wordmark on dark chocolate brown
whatItIs: A dark chocolate brown field with a pale butter-yellow logo: a leaping dachshund silhouette above a heavy rounded lowercase wordmark 'boop' where the two Os are joined and the p has a long descender, followed by a small ®.
whatItMeans: Playful and warm; the dog leaping over the letters brings movement and personality.
techniques: Perch a silhouette above a heavy wordmark.
Join letters like the Os for a bone shape.

vocabulary.definition: An animal shown as a solid shape.
Letters merged to form one shape.
A logo in one colour on one background.
